public_rationale: On the ordinary product-progress reading, Duplex had moved materially beyond a limited demo before this post. Google reported large-scale completed use, highly automated calls, and an additional telephone function through Hold for Me. This does not establish general conversational intelligence. If Marcus meant only progress toward unrestricted conversation, these records would not settle that narrower reading; the interpretation flag is therefore material.
limitations: The degree of progress is qualitative.
Business-hour inquiries were already contemplated in the original announcement.
Hold for Me initially had limited device and country availability.
Deployment scale does not by itself prove general language understanding.
